smallest_proposed_fix.policy: For verified ordinary planar rectangular 3D window quads, derive local along-wall width from max(profile_xy dot u)-min(profile_xy dot u), where u is the nonzero horizontal edge direction. Keep sill/bottom, height, 0.10m declared thickness, room shift and deterministic orientation. Use corrected footprint consistently in piece dedup. Preserve axis-aligned controls; do not silently extrapolate this fix to irregular door/bay-window 2D profiles.
smallest_proposed_fix.reason: Exporter width is explicitly max world X/Y span; adapter wrongly interprets it as local wall-aligned width. Exporter follows its documented contract; fix consumer semantics.
smallest_proposed_fix.source_to_IR: Raw house metres Y-up [x,y,z] -> [x,-z,y]; export profile already right-handed Z-up. subtract frame_shift for IL3D origin; openings emits rotation z=degrees(wall_angle)+90, furniture_size=[depth,width,height]; convert_room(front_offset_deg=-90) swaps first two dimensions and restores wall_angle, then subtracts boundary min XY. No raw source mutation.
tests: All39 confirmed saved cases and available69 strict historical raw-window locators; full source profile fixtures before/after.
Axis-aligned ordinary window unchanged; slanted 30/45-degree quad encloses all projected corners.
Profile corner cyclic permutation/reversal preserves unoriented box; deterministic yaw rule.
Sill+height unchanged, 0.10m thickness remains declared approximation, duplicate-piece merging and neighboring doors unchanged unless directly proven defect.
Regression still distinguishes window fixed_collisions from exempted fixed_blocking; no claim direct admission change.

smallest_proposed_fix.policy: For tilted source items, take unscaled +/-size/2 corners through original source_fields.transform. Derive yaw-aligned enclosing extents and true world min_z/max_z. Preserve existing yaw/front convention and tilted flag. Use corrected export-yaw extents and true centre before existing center_z=True/front_offset=-90 conversion, so bottom is min_z after one subtraction; alternatively direct final-IR construction must not subtract height twice. Preserve no-tilt controls and explicit reflection semantics.
smallest_proposed_fix.formula: C=(signs*size/2)@M[:3,:3].T+M[:3,3]; Q=C@Rz(-theta).T; S=max(Q)-min(Q); bottom=min(C[:,2]); theta is fixed existing yaw (account -90 and width/length swap exactly once).

source_transform.source_points: native CAD corner = center + sign*bbox; world = t_cad + R_cad @ (scale_cad * corner); scan-local = inv(scale_scan) * R_scan.T @ (world-t_scan); final = axisAlignment @ [scan-local,1]
source_transform.matrix_for_unit_scan_scale: R = A3 @ Rscan.T @ Rcad @ B; B maps canonical Z-up [x,y,z] to CAD [x,z,-y]. Z-up size = [2*bbox_x*scale_x,2*bbox_z*scale_z,2*bbox_y*scale_y].
source_transform.upright_projection: Extents = abs(Q(export_yaw).T @ R) @ scaled_local_size; bottom = transformed center.z - extent_z/2. Apply documented floor policy, then unified front_offset+90.
source_transform.limit: Unit scale verified for 6 case scenes here, not independently for all 1506 annotations; broader worker claim must have its own full scan evidence.

smallest_proposed_fix.formula: At export yaw theta: extents=abs(Rz(theta).T @ R) @ scaled_local_size; world_bottom=export_center_z-extents_z/2. At final theta+90, exchange horizontal extents exactly once.

If drift exists, a separate versioned wrapper/derived manifest must explicitly bind parent manifest+old UID/split map to corrected IR and fresh prep outputs. Existing stock build/corpus does not supply this interface. Reject newly invalid parent UIDs and cross-split components as visible blockers/deltas rather than concealing them. Do not merely replace old IR hashes in an unchanged manifest or claim old flags are fresh.
